description: 40-episode held-out EVAL subset of capx_rats_all_combined_core_200_benchmark: 10 each of close / open / pick / pick_and_place. Sampled with random.Random(42).shuffle() over the core_200 benchmark.json, then [:10] per task_type. 5 trials each (--total-trials 5) => 200 rollouts. data_split = test.

selection.method: random.Random(42).shuffle() of core_200 benchmark.json, then [:10] per task_type

leaderboard_alignment.note: Compact 40-task core eval subset (test split), not the full 9-component All Combined leaderboard evaluation. Deeper upstream provenance (HuggingFace source bundles, per-component source paths) is recorded in the core_200 benchmark's own metadata.

determinism_contract.episode_state: Each selected episode preserves the source benchmark JSON replay spec: scene, robot pose/qpos, object poses, cameras, language, and task state.
determinism_contract.camera_replay: JsonEvalTaskSampler replays recorded cameras in benchmark mode; avoid injecting a separate eval camera system when exact camera replay is desired.

history: Replaces a previously copied-in core_200 (200-episode) metadata that described the wrong benchmark. Authoritative description: README.md in this directory.
